label: deliverable
title: Write a timeless, original, evocative stand-up comedy set inspired by the greatest comedy writers and...
purpose: Write a timeless, original, evocative stand-up comedy set inspired by the greatest comedy writers and standups of the past 50 years, but make it unique to you.
note: The colony works until every requirement below holds, then raises the bar and keeps going (see "level"): set "expand": false to let it finish, or "maxLevel" to change how far it goes. Edit a threshold, add or remove a requirement, and the colony follows the new definition on its next round.

checks.label: Plan: scope, parts, success criteria
checks.fix: Write docs/plan.md with three sections named Scope (what the purpose needs, who it is for), Parts (a bulleted or numbered list: one line per part the deliverable should contain: 6 to 12 parts, each on its own distinct topic with no overlap between them - later growth belongs in expansion, not in more plan lines) and Success criteria (how the owner can tell it worked). At least 120 words. Send it as one repo-file block.

checks.label: A finished part for every item in the plan
checks.fix: Write the next missing part as deliverables/parts/NN-topic.md (NN = 01, 02, ... in plan order), taking one item from the Parts list in docs/plan.md. At least 300 words of real substance. One part per cycle, whole file in one repo-file block.

checks.label: The finished deliverable
checks.fix: deliverables/final.md is assembled by the colony from deliverables/parts/ and deliverables/expansion/; do not write it. Write the next missing part instead.

checks.label: Supporting notes
checks.fix: Write docs/notes.md: the key facts, sources and reasoning behind deliverables/final.md. At least 150 words.

checks.label: No placeholder text
checks.fix: Replace every TODO / TBD / placeholder / "[insert ...]" / "(rest unchanged)" marker with the real content, using repo-edit on the file named in the problem.

checks.label: Calculations in the documents are correct
checks.fix: Recompute the calculation the problem names and correct it (or delete it) in the file named. Write only a result you have actually worked out; do not invent a value that makes an example look like it works.
